# Retext

> Retext is an open-source macOS menu-bar app (Swift 6, SwiftUI, Liquid Glass) that fixes grammar, translates and rewrites selected text in any app, in place, with one shortcut. It calls the user's installed Claude Code CLI (`claude -p`, default) or Codex CLI (`codex exec`, ChatGPT login) with the user's own login, or an OpenAI-compatible API, and pastes the result back with the original formatting. Apache-2.0. Requires macOS 26+.

Key facts:
- Shortcuts: ⌥Space opens a bar under the selection (type in its Instruction field or pick an action); ⌥1…⌥9 run actions directly while text is selected; Esc cancels; ⌘Z undoes. Optional "Preview before replacing" (Settings → General, off by default) shows the result with changes marked first: Return replaces, Esc discards, ⌘C copies; a click elsewhere or an app switch discards it.
- Default actions: Fix grammar, English, and a translation into the Mac's language when it isn't English. Up to 9 custom actions with their own prompts.
- Engine: one active provider. Claude Code: `claude -p` with tools, MCP and user settings disabled. ChatGPT: `codex exec` with tools off and a private CODEX_HOME. Custom: OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions`, key in the macOS Keychain. Three quality levels map to the provider's models: Medium (Claude `haiku`, default), High (`sonnet`, extra instructions) and Max (`opus`, extra instructions); Up/Down in the bar change the level for one run.
- Works in any app with selectable text via the macOS Accessibility API and a CGEvent tap; read-only text (web pages, PDFs) is copied to the clipboard instead of pasted.
- Local data: ~/Library/Application Support/Retext/{settings,history,usage}.json (history keeps the last 20 results, each with only the first 60 characters of its selection), instance.lock (one Retext at a time) and codex-home/ (private Codex home: a symlink to Codex's auth.json plus Codex's own state); the custom API key in the macOS Keychain (service `dev.hapd.retext`, the bundle id). No telemetry. Text goes only to the chosen provider (Claude Code to Anthropic, Codex to OpenAI, or the custom API's URL); apart from a custom API, the only request Retext makes itself is an optional daily update check to api.github.com.
- Install: build from source (below); GitHub releases have no built app yet. A signed DMG and a Homebrew cask are planned for a later release.
- Update check: at most once a day, at launch and when the Mac wakes, Retext asks the GitHub releases API for the latest version and shows "Update available" in the menu; it can be turned off in Settings → Overview, and "Check for Updates…" in the menu-bar menu opens Settings → Overview and checks on demand.
- Build from source: `./build.sh` (Xcode 26+; builds into build.noindex/Retext.app and installs to ~/Applications). No third-party dependencies.
- Not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.

## Source
- [Sources/RetextCore](https://github.com/hlebtkachenko/retext/tree/main/Sources/RetextCore): settings, routing, prompts, cache, history, usage (tested)
- [Sources/Retext](https://github.com/hlebtkachenko/retext/tree/main/Sources/Retext): app, event tap, Accessibility, popup, settings window
